Project overview

Current project status

Three tasks remain.
sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: A text heading, description and body identify the group; imagery or card color is not its sole meaning.
updatesAndDescendants: Card and its slots are native div wrappers. CardTitle does not automatically become a heading, and the whole card is not inherently clickable. Parent content updates rerender normally; descendants own their actions.
referenceDecision: The h2 is deliberately supplied as CardTitle children in this reference. Consumers choose heading level from document hierarchy.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.
